title: Differences in Coagulation Test Kits
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to assess the effect of Innovin® reagent on laboratory results when compared with the Thromborel® S.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Routine control patients receiving and not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

Hemolytic and/or lipemic samples were excluded.
study_population: Patients receiving and not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy
